title: Retirement Age Law, 5764-2004
source_id: ס״ח תשס״ד, 150; Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000147; Wikisource page חוק גיל פרישה
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page. Heading prints חוק גיל פרישה, התשס״ד–2004; metadata gives ס״ח תשס״ד, 150 and Knesset lawitemid 2000147; last amendment noted תשפ״ב (2022). Section headings read: s 3 retirement age (גיל פרישה), s 4 mandatory retirement age (גיל פרישת חובה), s 5 early retirement age (גיל פרישה מוקדמת). Section 33 and the amendment schedule cross-refer to the National Insurance Law, 5755-1995 (ss 158, 160, 166, 171, 269א).
notes: This is the statute that fixes the retirement ages on which both National Insurance old-age pension and occupational pension entitlements turn, so it is a necessary companion to the two above. The women's retirement age is on a legislated gradual rise (the תשפ״א/תשפ״ב amendments); an encoding must therefore be date-parameterised by year of birth, not a single number. Sections 3-5 as read give 67 for men and a rising figure for women, 67 mandatory, 60 early.
text_format: MediaWiki source of the consolidated Hebrew text, with its citation apparatus (the ח:תיבה templates carry the Sefer HaChukim references and Knesset PDF links; ח:סעיף templates open each section)

The text is the law as maintained on Hebrew Wikisource at retrieval (page revision 2924417, last edited 2025-05-13T06:18:13Z), not a historical vintage.
